core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Ghulam corresponds to the Arabic form غُلام (Arabic root غ ل م (gh-l-m); غُلام (Ghulām)). Its core sense is servant, young man; servant (of god). Ghulam (غُلام) is Arabic for 'boy, young man, servant, slave', from the root غ ل م (gh-l-m). In naming it is overwhelmingly used as the first element of a compound, e.g. غلام محمد 'servant of Muhammad'. The source gloss 'servant of God' reflects that compound pattern rather than the meaning of the bare word; it is not by itself a divine-name theophoric.
